1. Agreement

These Terms of Service govern your use of ResumeNowOnline, including its website, résumé templates, editor, accounts and PDF export service. By using the service or creating an account, you agree to these terms and acknowledge our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, do not use the service.

2. Eligibility and accounts

You must be legally able to enter into this agreement. If you are under the age of legal majority where you live, you may use the service only with permission from a parent or guardian. Provide accurate account information, keep your password confidential and notify us if you suspect unauthorized access. You are responsible for activity under your account.

3. Free editor and paid exports

You may select templates, edit résumé content and preview the result without charge. The Resume Export Pack is a one-time purchase of $5 USD and includes three PDF download credits. It is not a subscription. A free account is required to purchase and use credits.

One credit is consumed when a PDF export is initiated. Credits are linked to the purchasing account, have no cash value and may not be transferred, resold or shared as a standalone product. Taxes may be added based on your location.

4. Payments

Payments are processed by Creem, which acts as merchant of record and handles checkout, tax calculation, receipts, refunds and chargebacks. Creem’s buyer terms and privacy terms also apply to the transaction. We do not store your complete payment card details.

5. Refunds

Refund eligibility is described in our Refund Policy. Nothing in these terms limits non-waivable consumer rights that apply where you live.

6. Your content

You retain ownership of the résumé text, images and other content you provide. You give ResumeNowOnline the limited permission necessary to display, edit and export that content at your direction. You are responsible for ensuring that your content is accurate, lawful and that you have the right to use it.

7. Templates and permitted use

ResumeNowOnline and its licensors retain rights in the templates, interface, software, branding and other service materials. We grant you a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable license to customize templates and use exported résumés for your own job search, professional profile and personal career purposes.

You may not resell, redistribute or publish the templates as templates; remove ownership notices; copy or reverse engineer the service; use automated systems to scrape or overload it; or use it to violate another person’s rights or applicable law.

8. Availability and changes

We may update, add or remove templates and features, and may suspend access for maintenance, security, abuse or legal reasons. We aim for reliable service but do not promise uninterrupted availability. Local browser data can be lost if browser storage is cleared or unavailable, so keep copies of important information.

9. No employment guarantee

ResumeNowOnline is a document creation tool. We do not guarantee that a résumé will pass an applicant tracking system, produce interviews, lead to employment or be accepted by any employer. Career content is general information, not legal, recruiting or professional advice.

10. Disclaimers and liability

To the extent permitted by law, the service is provided “as is” and “as available,” without warranties not expressly stated here. ResumeNowOnline will not be liable for indirect, incidental, special or consequential losses, lost opportunities or loss of locally stored content. Where liability cannot legally be excluded, it will be limited only to the maximum extent permitted by applicable law.

11. Ending use

You may stop using the service at any time. We may suspend or terminate access when these terms are materially violated, the service is abused, or action is needed for security or legal compliance. Provisions that by their nature should survive will continue after termination.

12. Changes and contact

We may update these terms as the service changes. The effective date above will show the latest version, and additional notice will be provided where required. Questions can be sent to support@resume-now.online.
